newsitem.title: USA: Thomaston says in midst of denim glut.
newsitem.headline: Thomaston says in midst of denim glut.

text.p: Thomaston Mills said it is experiencing slowness and reduced pricing in the denim fabric area.
The company also said there is an oversupply of denim which will last at least through its third quarter.
The company did not say how the slowness, reduced pricing or oversupply would impact its earnings. Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
On Monday, the company reported that it lost $0.11 per share in its second quarter ended December 28, compared with $0.14 per share in the year-earlier period.
